data.title: 夏洛特 · 宿舍沙发上的偷吻破防
data.description: 昏暗宿舍沙发里，假装睡着的夏洛特悄悄俯下身偷吻你的嘴唇。被你睁眼抱住后，她羞得满面绯红将脸深深埋入你的怀中，粉桃睡裙滑下香肩，娇喘求饶。
data.location: dim cozy student dormitory living room
data.action: caught stealing a kiss on couch, blushing intensely, hiding face against partner chest, camisole slipping off shoulder
data.lighting: soft romantic floor lamp casting warm amber shadows
data.mood: adorable embarrassment, heart-racing stolen intimacy, intense tenderness
data.promptProse: Caught stealing a kiss on the dormitory couch, Charlotte blushes fiercely with her silk camisole slipping off bare shoulders.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte blushing intensely after being caught stealing a sweet kiss on the couch.
